text.en: Visual Curator now keeps focal subjects distinct from supporting objects during wallpaper planning, retries and review. It also preserves candidate placement and checks generated canvases before ESPCN reconstruction.
text.zh-CN: 修复多物体扩图的主次识别、候选对齐和重试摆放问题；规划与复审分别检查主角安全区和陪衬保真，生成图通过后才执行 ESPCN 超分。
